Do not preserve the oversized blank regions from Image 1. Create a standalone portrait 3:4 illustration, full bleed. Use the painterly Chinese ink-and-watercolor detail and strong substantial composition seen in Image 2, with restrained cinnabar accents. Important: the scene must feel like a FULL WALLPAPER IMAGE covering the whole card, not a decorative corner with empty paper. NO frame, NO rounded corners, NO card shadow, NO labels, NO calligraphy, NO Chinese/English text, NO placeholder bars, NO watermark, NO seal; the app overlays clean gray bars later. The localized quiet pocket should occupy at most 15–20% of the total image area and belong naturally to the scene, as mist, sky or water; do not isolate it as a blank rectangular panel. All four edges should have pictorial continuity. Scene:
